reference: By August he will have been hiking these trails for ten years.
sk: V auguste to už bude desať rokov, čo chodí po týchto chodníkoch.
cz: V srpnu to už bude deset let, co chodí po těchhle cestách.
acceptable: {By|In} August he will have been {hiking|walking} {on |}these {trails|paths} for ten years.
He will have been {hiking|walking} {on |}these {trails|paths} for ten years {by|in} August.

mistakes.text: {By|In} August he will be hiking these trails for ten years.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Trvanie až do budúceho bodu vyjadruje Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Trvání až do budoucího bodu vyjadřuje Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Duration up to a future point needs the Future Perfect Continuous: “will have been hiking”.

mistakes.text: {By|In} August he will have hiked these trails for ten years.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dlhom trvajúcom deji („for ten years“) sa lepšie hodí Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U dlouho trvajícího děje („for ten years“) se lépe hodí Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For an ongoing activity (“for ten years”), the Future Perfect Continuous “will have been hiking” fits better.

mistakes.text: {By|In} August he has been hiking these trails for ten years.
mistakes.feedback_sk: August je v budúcnosti, preto nie „has been“, ale „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Srpen je v budoucnosti, proto ne „has been“, ale „will have been hiking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: August is in the future, so not “has been” but “will have been hiking”.

mistakes.text: {By|In} August he will have been hiking these trails since ten years.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dĺžke trvania patrí „for“, nie „since“: „for ten years“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U délky trvání patří „for“, ne „since“: „for ten years“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “for” with a length of time, not “since”: “for ten years”.

mistakes.text: In August it will be ten years since he started hiking these trails.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Future Perfect Continuous: „he will have been hiking … for ten years“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Future Perfect Continuous: „he will have been hiking … for ten years“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Future Perfect Continuous: “he will have been hiking … for ten years”.

mistakes.text: {By|In} August he will have been hiking this trails for ten years.
mistakes.feedback_en: With a plural noun use “these”: “these trails”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'In August it will be ten years since he walks these paths' (V auguste / V srpnu), not 'By August'; 'In August' is accepted too.
